newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books says starts new unit.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books says starts new unit.

text.p: Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc said Monday it will establish a new business unit within its children's publishing group called Golden Value Books and Special Markets.
The unit will pursue specialty publishing opportunities outside of traditional retail channels.
The company also said it named Stephen Weitzman president of the new unit. Weitzman was formally vice president of sales and marketing at Modern Publishing, which he joined in 1993.
The company said the new unit will operate independently of the core publishing unit, with its own sales and product and development staff.
